About UPS & Our Culture

When UPS says immediate hire, we mean it. During peak season, our package center teams expand by thousands of associates in a matter of weeks, and we have built our onboarding system to get people working — and getting paid — as fast as any warehouse employer in America. If you are searching for seasonal warehouse jobs hiring immediately with a brand name you trust, competitive hourly pay, and a genuine shot at a permanent career, our Peak Warehouse Sorter position is open and ready for you right now. No lengthy application process, no multi-week waiting period — UPS peak hiring is designed for speed because the packages do not wait for anyone.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I applied on a Monday and was working by Thursday. The onboarding process at UPS during peak is extremely fast and well-organized — they know how to bring large numbers of people in quickly without it feeling chaotic. The pay was better than I expected for a seasonal warehouse job hiring immediately, the overtime was genuinely available, and I was offered a permanent position before the season even ended." - Former Peak Sorter, Now Permanent Associate, Seattle, WA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorter, you join our package center sort operation during the November-through-January holiday window, processing the highest package volumes of the year with speed and accuracy that keeps America's holiday delivery commitments intact.

  • Rapid Onboarding & Immediate Start: Complete UPS's streamlined peak-season onboarding process — safety orientation, method training, and first sort shift — within days of your offer letter, with your first paycheck arriving the following week without exception.

  • Overtime Priority Access: As a seasonal sorter during peak, you have first access to available overtime hours during the highest-volume weeks — Black Friday, Cyber Monday, pre-Christmas — generating a seasonal paycheck significantly larger than standard hours provide.

Benefits & Perks

Associates who demonstrate performance and reliability during the seasonal period receive formal permanent hire consideration — converting a temporary position into a Teamsters union career complete with medical, dental, vision, pension, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition benefits.

jobs.description:
Position in Chicago, IL

Snapshot

  • Employer: United Parcel Service (UPS) (Hiring in Chicago)
  • Position: UPS Preload Package Handler (Flexible/Contract, Chicago)
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our United Parcel Service (UPS) team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Warehousing And Logistics industry.

Salary and Benefits

  • Compensation: $1.5k-$2.5k/Month (approx. $24k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Chicago location.

Build the Route Before the Sun Comes Up

Every morning, thousands of UPS drivers jump into perfectly loaded trucks, turn the key, and hit the road. That seamless execution is only possible because of the UPS Preload Package Handler. Operating during the very early morning hours (typically 3:00 AM to 8:00 AM), you are the architect of the delivery route. You will stand inside the back of the brown package cars, catching packages off a high-speed conveyor belt and loading them sequentially based on the driver's route map. If you want a fast-paced, intensely physical part-time job that provides incredible union benefits and frees up your entire day, this is the most critical warehouse role at UPS.

Preload Operations

  • High-Speed Package Sorting: Read alphanumeric routing codes on packages flying down the conveyor belt. You must quickly identify which packages belong to the 3 or 4 trucks you are assigned to load.
  • Sequential Truck Loading: This is a game of high-stakes Tetris. You must physically load the packages onto the specific interior shelves of the package car in the exact order the driver will deliver them, ensuring the heaviest boxes are safely secured on the floor.
  • Extreme Physical Conditioning: Skip the gym forever. You will be continuously twisting, bending, reaching, and lifting packages weighing up to 70 pounds for 4 to 5 hours straight in a fast-paced, loud, industrial environment.
  • Quality Control: Identify leaking, crushed, or mislabeled packages and pull them off the line for the problem-solve team before they are loaded onto the delivery truck.

The Part-Time Union Advantage

The UPS Preload position is legendary for its benefits. Even as a part-time employee, after a brief waiting period, you receive the same zero-premium, top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance as full-time drivers. You are protected by the Teamsters union, receive regular wage increases, and get access to the "Earn and Learn" program, which provides massive tuition assistance for college students. Most importantly, Preload is the primary waiting list to become a highly-paid UPS Delivery Driver.

Requirements

Must be at least 18 years old. No driving license is required for this warehouse role. You must possess extreme physical stamina and athletic endurance to handle continuous heavy lifting up to 70 lbs. You must have the discipline to wake up and work extremely early morning hours (e.g., 3:00 AM starts). A reliable work ethic and ability to pass a background check are mandatory.

The global reach of FedEx is powered by our incredibly advanced network of processing hubs and distribution centers. Behind every package safely delivered is a dedicated team working diligently to sort, route, and load freight with speed and precision. jobs.description:
Join Shipoom as a Yard Jockey/Package Handler!

Looking for a dynamic role where you can put your skills to work and be part of a fast-paced logistics team? Shipoom, a leader in same-day and last-mile delivery services, is hiring a Yard Jockey/Package Handler! If you’re ready to contribute to seamless supply chain operations and help deliver exceptional customer experiences, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

As a Yard Jockey/Package Handler at Shipoom, you’ll wear multiple hats to keep our logistics operations running smoothly. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Docking and removing incoming trailers when needed.
  • Operating a warehouse tractor to move trailers with minimal movement required.
  • Unloading, sorting, and staging products in designated areas.
  • Maintaining a clean and organized work area.
  • Collaborating with team members to ensure an efficient workflow.

This role combines yard jockey duties with warehouse tasks, so you’ll be active throughout your shift.

What We’re Looking For

To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

  • A valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • A Commercial Driver License (CDL) A (required).
  • At least 1 year of experience operating trailers.
  • Previous experience in a warehouse or distribution center (preferred).
  • The ability to team lift, lower, and slide packages up to 100 lbs.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with warehouse operations and procedures.
  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

This position requires standing, walking, bending, and lifting throughout your entire shift. Open and weekend availability is a must.

Perks and Benefits

At Shipoom, we value our team members and offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • 401(k) with matching contributions.
  • Dental insurance.
  • Vision insurance.
Why Join Shipoom?

At Shipoom, we pride ourselves on being a trusted partner in logistics for Big Box stores and Fulfillment Centers. Our team is dedicated to delivering reliable and efficient solutions, and we believe in fostering a supportive and collaborative work environment. When you join Shipoom, you’re joining a team that values hard work, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re a motivated individual with the skills and experience to thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Shipoom team, where your contributions make a difference every day.

jobs.description:
• $18.00 - $20.00/HR salary range + annual bonus potential!
  • Onsite Monday- Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM in our Chicago, IL warehouse

Do you hunger for more? Potbelly Sandwich Shop is looking for friendly and outgoing people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, friendly environment. We are where good vibes and great careers are a way of life! What started as a small antique store in 1977 has become a nationally recognized neighborhood sandwich shop with over 400 locations across the United States. But toasty sandwiches are only as good as the people behind them. And yeah, we've got the best. Ready to join our growing Potbelly Nation?

What’s In It For You**:

  • Competitive pay with performance-based annual raises!
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Domestic Partnership Benefits
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • FSA and HSA with Employer Contribution
  • Commuter Benefit Program
  • Retirement Savings 401(k) WITH company match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid Time Off
  • Discount Program
  • Flexible Work Schedule
  • Career growth opportunities

**If hired, you must meet and maintain all eligibility requirements to qualify**

No two days in our warehouse look the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.

One day you might be gathering and staging materials for a brand-new Potbelly shop getting ready to open. The next, you could be packaging individual items for shipping to existing shops, cleaning and organizing the warehouse, or helping prep millwork and materials for finishing.

If you’re mechanically minded, enjoy working with your hands, and tackling unique projects, you’ll fit right in. Our warehouse team keeps things moving behind the scenes and plays a huge role in helping our shops succeed.

This isn’t a sit-at-a-desk-all-day kind of job. It’s hands-on, fast-paced, physical work where teamwork, organization, and problem-solving matter. If you like variety, staying busy, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll probably love it here.

FOCUS

Responsibilities

  • Pulls and distributes materials, artifacts, or other stock items to fill orders.
  • Prepares and packages goods for shipping.
  • Maintains accurate inventory records using inventory software.
  • Receives goods and enters all items into inventory.
  • Operates material handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, etc.
  • Loads trucks with goods, makes deliveries, and picks up material from local vendors.
  • Keeps the warehouse clean and organized.
  • Assists carpenters and painters with prepping material for finishing.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Essential Physical Functions

  • Must be able to work overtime when needed.
  • Will frequently reach, feel, bend, stoop, carry, finely manipulate, and key in data.
  • Must be able to work in both warm and cool environments, indoors and outdoors.
  • Ability to stand/walk for 9-10 hours per day and sit for 1-2 hours per day.
  • Must be able to lift up to 75 pounds frequently.
  • Must be able to communicate through telephone, e-mail and in-person communications.

Experience, Education And Behaviors

  • Previous experience in a warehouse or logistics environment preferred.
  • Experience operating a forklift required.
  • Must represent The Potbelly Way.
  • Minimum high school degree.
  • Must have basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Must have valid driver’s license.
  • Must be very neat and organized.
  • Must be familiar with and comfortable with using basic hand and power tools.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills are essential, along with the ability to interact with all levels of a company.
  • Must demonstrate leadership behaviors and values that align with Potbelly.

Potbelly Sandwich Works may use artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted tools as part of its hiring and recruitment process. These tools may collect and analyze data including questionnaire and assessment responses, resume content, and professional profile information. AI-assisted tools are used for all position types. All final employment decisions are made by people. Potbelly may also use additional AI-assisted tools from time to time in its hiring process.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. Each applicant will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: 3PL Pick & Pack Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Join a dynamic logistics team as a 3PL Pick & Pack Warehouse Associate, where your energy and attention to detail will drive efficient order fulfillment and inventory management. In this vital role, you will be responsible for accurately picking, packing, and preparing shipments for delivery, ensuring that each customer receives their order promptly and in perfect condition. Your proactive approach and commitment to safety will help maintain smooth warehouse operations, supporting the overall success of our distribution process. This position offers an exciting opportunity to develop your skills in warehouse management systems, join a fast growing company, and contribute to a team oriented environment.

Responsibilities

  • Efficiently pick items using order picker equipment, RF scanners, barcode scanning technology, and manual handling techniques to fulfill customer orders accurately.
  • Pack products securely using appropriate packaging materials, ensuring quality control standards are met before shipment.
  • Operate warehouse equipment such as pallet stackers, pallet jacks, and other equipment safely following all safety protocols.
  • Load and unload shipments with precision, managing shipping & receiving processes while adhering to safety guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records within warehouse management systems (WMS) and conduct regular stock checks to support inventory management systems.
  • Assist with stocking bins and organizing materials within the warehouse for optimal workflow.
  • Support warehouse supervisors in daily operations.

Experience

  • Prior experience working in a warehouse environment or distribution center is preferred but not required; on the job training will be provided.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS), RF scanners, barcode scanning for logistics, and inventory management systems is highly advantageous.
  • Experience operating heavy equipment such as pallet stackers, pallet jacks, or similar material handling equipment is a plus.
  • Knowledge of safety protocols related to manual handling, heavy lifting, shipping & receiving procedures is essential.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform basic math calculations accurately for inventory counts and order processing.
  • Previous roles involving picking & packing, materials handling, or warehouse distribution contribute to success in this position.

This role is perfect for motivated individuals eager to grow their skills in warehouse operations while making a tangible impact on customer satisfaction through efficient logistics processes. We are committed to providing a safe work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized!

Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

jobs.description:
Company Overview: FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI’s foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI’s innovations lead the way! Won’t you join us? Responsibilities:

  • Safely and efficiently operate a forklift to move materials, products, and equipment within the warehouse or production area.
  • Load and unload trucks, stack and store materials in designated areas.
  • Perform routine pre and post-operational forklift inspections to ensure equipment is in proper working condition.
  • Follow safety protocols and guidelines to prevent accidents and injuries.
  • Communicate and coordinate with other team members to ensure the timely completion of tasks.
  • Maintain accurate records of inventory movement, including quantities, locations, and timestamps.
  • Assist in maintaining a clean and organized warehouse or production floor.
  • Report any equipment malfunctions or maintenance needs to the supervisor.
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures related to forklift operation and safety.
  • Participate in training programs to stay updated on forklift operation best practices. Qualifiations:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid forklift operator certification/license.
  • Proven experience as a forklift operator in a warehouse or production environment.
  • Strong knowledge of forklift operation and safety procedures.
  • Ability to operate forklifts in a variety of environments, including narrow aisles and tight spaces.
  • Physical strength and stamina to handle the demands of forklift operation.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in inventory tracking.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours and overtime as needed.
